figurative_meaning_en: synonymous compound word for job, livelihood, profession
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কাজকর্ম কী? সে একটা দোকান চালায়।
example_sentences_in_english: What is his line of work? He runs a shop.
Life doesn't go on without a job or livelihood.
note: This is a tautological compound word commonly used in Bengali to refer to one's profession or means of earning.
